name: Morrisville House of Pizza
tagline: Family-owned pizza in Mountain View Plaza, Morrisville, VT. Serving the area for about 30 years.
seo_title: Morrisville House of Pizza | Family-Owned Pizza in Morrisville, VT
seo_desc: Morrisville House of Pizza, Mountain View Plaza, Morrisville VT. Family-owned for about 30 years. Open Tuesday to Saturday. Call (802) 888-5200.
about: Morrisville House of Pizza is a family-owned pizza shop in Mountain View Plaza in Morrisville, Vermont, serving the community for about 30 years.
The shop takes orders by phone. Call (802) 888-5200 to order.
menu_note: The shop's full menu with prices is on its own website. This concept does not reproduce it: call (802) 888-5200 to order or to ask about items and prices.
findings: Ziplocal/Divi template ("Powered by Ziplocal", "Designed by Elegant Themes") with only three pages.
Homepage is one paragraph and a Menu button; the only images are the logo and one 2017 cover photo.
Header "Order Now" is plain text beside the phone number: there is no online ordering, only calling.
Menu is a long text-only price list with no photos.
Page titles are keyword-stuffed and do not match the pages (e.g. "Cheese Calzones in Morrisville, VT" on the Menu page).
Hours (Tue-Sat 11-8) appear only on the Contact page, and the address wording differs between footer ("30 Mountain Plaza") and Contact page ("30 Mountain View Plaza").
No social links on the site; a Facebook page named "House of Pizza" with a matching Morrisville address was found in a public listing.
questions: Do you have photos of your food and shop we may use? The old site has only a logo and one 2017 cover photo.
Can you confirm the correct street address: 30 Mountain Plaza or 30 Mountain View Plaza?
Can you confirm hours: Tuesday to Saturday, 11am to 8pm, closed Sunday and Monday?
Is https://www.facebook.com/pages/House-of-Pizza/119648414768703 your Facebook page? Do you have Instagram?
Would you like online ordering, or phone only? Can you send your current menu with prices?
